newsitem.title: USA: IFR Systems Q3 net climbs with margins.
newsitem.headline: IFR Systems Q3 net climbs with margins.

text.p: IFR Systems Inc said Wednesday higher margins helped the company post a 17-percent gain in earnings in the third quarter ended March 31.

The electronic fiber optic test equipment maker said net income reached $1.7 million, or $0.30 a share, versus $1.5 million, or $0.26 a share a year ago. Revenues increased to $26.2 million from $22.8 million in the same period in 1996.
IFR said its gross margin improved to 42 percent of revenue, compared with 38 percent one year ago, as worldwide demand for wireless communications test instruments rises.
IFR shares were up 1/2 Wednesday at 15-1/2.
